name: Onset Dedicated Server
description: Install the Onset dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Linux server directly.
known_limitations: Game mode packages and advanced server configuration must be managed in the server files.
Stop uses the bounded terminate fallback.

requirements.description: The reviewed Pelican launch targets the native Linux server.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.

help.summary: GameNode installs Steam App 1204170 anonymously and starts OnsetServer directly.

findings.summary: Game modes and advanced settings remain file-managed.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers
